DMARC · what receivers do with mail that fails SPF and DKIM
: mail that fails DMARC is refused outright.
Without rua=, receivers don't send aggregate reports, so you can't see who sends mail as example.com
or whether your own mail passes.
Add rua=mailto:<address>, such as a dmarc-reports@example.com mailbox or a DMARC reporting
